recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not convert these elements to CodeableReference or a literal choice unless a later triaged issue is resolved to make that breaking model change.
issue_request: FHIR-5643 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care issue asking to change Procedure.bodySite and Condition.location to a bodySite choice of CodeableConcept or Reference(BodySite), as a follow-up to FHIR-3600.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn 4981. The git-svn commit f734eb20e9cea5803c519475780be919724f148f cites {#5643}; it changed Condition.location.code to Condition.location.site[x] with type CodeableConcept | Reference(BodySite), removed Condition.location.detail, and updated the Condition location search path. Procedure already had Procedure.bodySite.site[x] CodeableConcept|Reference(BodySite) before and after that commit, while the same commit's Procedure change was Procedure.used.
additional_context: FHIR-3600 established the broader body-site harmonization direction. Later history moved Condition from Condition.location to Condition.bodySite, renamed BodySite to BodyStructure, and added separate Condition.bodyStructure and Procedure.bodyStructure Reference(BodyStructure) elements. FHIR-39630 and FHIR-39288 explicitly used separate bodyStructure elements rather than a literal choice/CodeableReference for compatibility. Related sibling issues FHIR-5644 and FHIR-5645, and Procedure target-site clarification FHIR-7630, are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current source has no obsolete Condition.location; Condition and Procedure each expose coded bodySite plus BodyStructure reference support in the modern compatible form.
